title: Call for AI Research in RTS Games
venue: AAAI Workshop on Challenges in Game AI
why_anghel: Foundational RTS-AI call framing Broadside/GRID COMMAND problems: incomplete info, real-time control, multi-agent coordination.
abstract_or_blurb: Argues RTS games are an ideal AI challenge domain beyond classical board games, highlighting incomplete information, real-time constraints, and large action spaces.

title: Real-Time Strategy Games: A New AI Research Challenge
why_anghel: Classic framing of RTS as research challenge; seeds Broadside strategy-agent and fog-of-war agendas.
abstract_or_blurb: Positions real-time strategy games as a new AI research challenge requiring planning, learning, and opponent modeling under severe time and information constraints.

title: A Survey of Real-Time Strategy Game AI Research and Competition in StarCraft
why_anghel: Canonical StarCraft RTS-AI survey; map of solved vs open problems for Broadside seeding.
abstract_or_blurb: Surveys RTS AI with emphasis on StarCraft as a unified testbed, summarizing challenges, approaches, competition bots, and open problems.

title: The Current State of StarCraft AI Competitions and Bots
why_anghel: Competition landscape (AIIDE/CIG/SSCAIT) for benchmarking Broadside RTS agents.
abstract_or_blurb: Overview of major StarCraft AI competitions and the bots that compete in them.

title: StarCraft II: A New Challenge for Reinforcement Learning
why_anghel: PySC2/SC2LE environment — primary modern RTS RL testbed for Broadside agents and fog-of-war.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces the StarCraft II Learning Environment and PySC2 as a challenge domain for deep RL under partial observability and huge action spaces.

title: Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning
why_anghel: AlphaStar landmark multi-agent RL result; architecture lessons for Broadside strategy agents.
abstract_or_blurb: AlphaStar reaches Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning and league training under fog of war.

title: The StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge
why_anghel: SMAC benchmark for cooperative micromanagement under partial observability — core squad coordination testbed.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces SMAC, a cooperative multi-agent RL benchmark based on StarCraft II micromanagement with partial observability.

title: Build Order Optimization in StarCraft
why_anghel: Classic build-order search for RTS production planning in Broadside.
abstract_or_blurb: Presents search methods for optimal StarCraft build orders used in competitive bots.

title: Portfolio Greedy Search and Simulation for Large-Scale Combat in StarCraft
why_anghel: Combat simulation plus portfolio greedy search for Broadside unit micromanagement.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces Portfolio Greedy Search for large-scale StarCraft combat using fast combat simulation and script portfolios.

title: A Particle Model for State Estimation in Real-Time Strategy Games
why_anghel: Fog-of-war unit tracking via particle filters for Broadside scouting/state estimation.
abstract_or_blurb: Learns a particle model from StarCraft replays to estimate enemy unit locations under fog of war.

title: Inferring Strategies from Limited Reconnaissance in Real-time Strategy Games
why_anghel: Bayesian strategy inference from limited scouting — core opponent-modeling under fog of war.
abstract_or_blurb: Dynamic Bayesian network for inferring StarCraft opening strategies from partial observations and scouting effort.

title: A Bayesian model for opening prediction in RTS games with application to StarCraft
why_anghel: Opening prediction under uncertainty for Broadside adaptive strategy selection.
abstract_or_blurb: Bayesian model for predicting opponent openings in StarCraft from early-game observations.

title: Forward Modeling for Partial Observation Strategy Games - A StarCraft Defogger
why_anghel: Neural defogger for StarCraft state estimation — key partial-observability technique.
abstract_or_blurb: Formulates RTS defogging as forward modeling from partial observations and evaluates encoder-decoder models on StarCraft.

title: DefogGAN: Predicting Hidden Information in the StarCraft Fog of War with Generative Adversarial Nets
why_anghel: GAN-based fog-of-war inference for Broadside perception modules.
abstract_or_blurb: Conditional GAN approach that generates defogged StarCraft game states from partial observations.

title: The Combinatorial Multi-Armed Bandit Problem and Its Application to Real-Time Strategy Games
why_anghel: CMAB framing for RTS combinatorial actions — useful for Broadside online decision policies.
abstract_or_blurb: Applies combinatorial multi-armed bandits to RTS decision making and evaluates in microRTS-style settings.

title: Case-Based Planning and Execution for Real-Time Strategy Games
why_anghel: Early Darmok/WARGUS CBR planning — precedent for case libraries of tactics in Broadside.
abstract_or_blurb: Case-based planning and execution for RTS games demonstrated in WARGUS, learning plans from demonstration.

title: Search-Based Procedural Content Generation: A Taxonomy and Survey
why_anghel: Canonical SBPCG taxonomy — foundation for Broadside procedural worlds.
abstract_or_blurb: Defines and surveys search-based procedural content generation, providing a taxonomy of representations, search algorithms, and evaluation functions.

title: Experience-Driven Procedural Content Generation
why_anghel: EDPCG framework linking player models to generators for adaptive Broadside scenarios.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces experience-driven PCG driven by computational models of user experience, with games as the primary application.

title: Procedural Content Generation via Machine Learning (PCGML)
why_anghel: PCGML survey — ML-based generation path for Broadside levels/maps/entities.
abstract_or_blurb: Surveys procedural content generation via machine learning, covering representations, models, and evaluation practices.

title: Automatic Content Generation in the Galactic Arms Race Video Game
why_anghel: Classic cgNEAT content evolution in a shipped game — precedent for online generative content.
abstract_or_blurb: Describes Galactic Arms Race, which evolves player weapons online using collaborative content generation with NEAT.

title: General Video Game AI: Competition, Challenges and Opportunities
why_anghel: GVGAI competition framing general game agents — transferable strategy skills beyond one title.
abstract_or_blurb: Presents the General Video Game AI competition, challenges, and opportunities for general game-playing agents.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Games
why_anghel: Standard textbook synthesizing game AI and PCG — orientation map for Broadside seed digests.
abstract_or_blurb: Comprehensive textbook covering game-playing agents, player modeling, and procedural content generation.

title: Procedural Content Generation in Games
why_anghel: PCG textbook covering constructive, search, and learning methods for Broadside world generation.
abstract_or_blurb: Textbook covering constructive, search-based, and learning-based methods for generating game content.

title: ALFRED: A Benchmark for Interpreting Grounded Instructions for Everyday Tasks
why_anghel: Landmark grounded instruction-following benchmark — methodology transferable to GRID COMMAND NL unit orders.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces ALFRED, a benchmark for mapping natural language instructions and egocentric vision to action sequences.

title: BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning
why_anghel: Curriculum platform for grounded language learning — design patterns for GRID COMMAND order language.
abstract_or_blurb: Presents BabyAI, a gridworld platform and curriculum for studying sample-efficient grounded language learning.

title: Learning to Speak and Act in a Fantasy Text Adventure Game
why_anghel: LIGHT dialogue+action dataset — dialogue-to-action precedent for GRID COMMAND adjacent systems.
abstract_or_blurb: Introduces LIGHT, a large-scale crowdsourced fantasy text adventure dataset pairing dialogue and embodied actions.

title: Graph Constrained Language-Action Co-evolution for Text Games
why_anghel: Language-action co-evolution with graph beliefs for dialogue-conditioned orders under partial info.
abstract_or_blurb: Proposes graph-constrained co-evolution of language and action policies for partially observable text games.

title: F.A.C.U.L.: Language-Based Interaction with AI Companions in Gaming
why_anghel: Real-time NL tactical orders to AI companions — closest published GRID COMMAND adjacent system.
abstract_or_blurb: Real-time FPS AI companion system that decomposes complex natural-language tactical commands and grounds them to entities and actions.

title: QMIX: Monotonic Value Function Factorisation for Deep Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
why_anghel: Standard value-factorisation MARL method on SMAC — baseline for Broadside squad coordination.

title: Value-Decomposition Networks For Cooperative Multi-Agent Learning
why_anghel: VDN baseline for cooperative MARL credit assignment across unit groups.
abstract_or_blurb: Proposes value-decomposition networks for cooperative multi-agent learning under decentralised execution.

title: Counterfactual Multi-Agent Policy Gradients
why_anghel: COMA counterfactual credit assignment for coordinating many Broadside units.

title: Multiagent Bidirectionally-Coordinated Nets for Learning to Play StarCraft Combat Games
why_anghel: Early deep MARL for StarCraft combat with bidirectional coordination.

title: STARDATA: A StarCraft AI Research Dataset
why_anghel: Large StarCraft replay dataset for imitation and opponent modeling.
abstract_or_blurb: Releases STARDATA, a large dataset of StarCraft: Brood War replays for AI research.

title: TorchCraft: a Library for Machine Learning Research on Real-Time Strategy Games
why_anghel: ML bridge to Brood War — tooling precedent for Broadside research hooks into RTS sims.
abstract_or_blurb: Presents TorchCraft, a library enabling machine learning research on StarCraft: Brood War.

title: Applying Goal-Driven Autonomy to StarCraft
why_anghel: Goal-driven autonomy in EISBot — goal management under dynamic RTS conditions.
abstract_or_blurb: Applies goal-driven autonomy to StarCraft, enabling agents to detect discrepancies and generate new goals.

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Real-Time Strategy Games
why_anghel: MCTS adapted to RTS combat — search baseline for Broadside tactics.

title: Large Language Models Play StarCraft II: Benchmarks and A Chain of Summarization Approach
why_anghel: TextStarCraft II + Chain of Summarization — NL interface to RTS decisions for GRID COMMAND/Broadside.

title: LLM-PySC2: Starcraft II learning environment for Large Language Models
why_anghel: Full PySC2 action space for LLMs with multi-agent support — Broadside LLM-agent harness reference.
abstract_or_blurb: Environment enabling LLMs to use the complete PySC2 action space with multi-agent collaboration support.

title: ROMA: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Emergent Roles
why_anghel: Emergent roles in MARL — maps to GRID COMMAND role tags and squad specialization.
abstract_or_blurb: Learns emergent roles to improve multi-agent coordination, evaluated on StarCraft micromanagement.

title: RODE: Learning Roles to Decompose Multi-Agent Tasks
why_anghel: Role learning to decompose multi-agent tasks — aligns with GRID COMMAND role-tagged orders.

title: On Reinforcement Learning for Full-length Game of StarCraft

title: TStarBots: Defeating the Cheating Level Builtin AI in StarCraft II in the Full Game
why_anghel: Early full-game SC2 RL bots defeating built-in AI — full-game training lessons.

title: MSC: A Dataset for Macro-Management in StarCraft II
why_anghel: Macro-management dataset from SC2 replays for Broadside economy/tech prediction.

title: Learning Macromanagement in StarCraft from Replays using Deep Learning
why_anghel: Replay-trained macromanagement — imitation path for Broadside openings.

title: Opponent Modeling in Real-Time Strategy Games

title: Predicting Army Combat Outcomes in StarCraft
why_anghel: Combat outcome prediction models for Broadside combat sims.

title: A Survey of Monte Carlo Tree Search Methods
why_anghel: Authoritative MCTS survey from CoG community — search toolkit for Broadside planners.
abstract_or_blurb: Comprehensive survey of Monte Carlo Tree Search methods and applications including games.

title: The Arcade Learning Environment: An Evaluation Platform for General Agents
why_anghel: ALE general-agent platform — historical CoG/AIIDE-adjacent benchmark culture.

title: Interactive Fiction Games: A Colossal Adventure
why_anghel: Jericho IF benchmark — language-action agents under partial observability; GRID COMMAND adjacent.

title: TextWorld: A Learning Environment for Text-based Games
why_anghel: Procedurally generated text games for language agents — NL grounding + PCG intersection.

why_anghel: RL grounding of instructions+vision to actions — transferable to NL unit command execution.
abstract_or_blurb: Uses RL to map natural language instructions and visual observations to action sequences.

why_anghel: Classic seq2seq instruction-to-action — lineage for GRID COMMAND NL order parsers.

why_anghel: Classic semantic parsing of instructions to actions — foundational for grounded NL game commands.

why_anghel: Early grounded direction following — historical NL-to-action grounding for GRID COMMAND.

title: Walk the Talk: Connecting Language, Knowledge, and Action in Route Instructions
why_anghel: Classic route-instruction execution (MARCO) — early grounded NL commands lineage.
abstract_or_blurb: Computational model connecting language, knowledge, and action for following route instructions.

why_anghel: Learning navigational NL interpretation from observations — grounding without full supervision.

why_anghel: Open-ended embodied agents with NL goals — GRID COMMAND-style open vocabulary orders.

why_anghel: Full MOBA RL — large-scale multi-agent coordination lessons transferable to RTS squads.

title: StarCraft AI Competitions, Bots, and Tournament Manager Software
why_anghel: Encyclopedia overview of StarCraft AI competitions and bots for Broadside benchmarking context.
abstract_or_blurb: Surveys StarCraft AI competitions, bots, and tournament management infrastructure.
